description: Structural induction for infinitary formulas ranges over every finite bound-slot context; at a countable conjunction its hypotheses include every conjunct.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.rec.{u_1, u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Finite α] {motive : (a : ℕ) → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α a → Sort u_1}
  (falsum : {n : ℕ} → motive n Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.falsum)
  (equal :
    {n : ℕ} → (t s : L.Term (α ⊕ Fin n)) → motive n (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.equal t s))
  (rel :
    {n k : ℕ} →
      (R : L.Relations k) →
        (ts : Fin k → L.Term (α ⊕ Fin n)) → motive n (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.rel R ts))
  (imp :
    {n : ℕ} →
      (φ ψ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) → motive n φ → motive n ψ → motive n (φ.imp ψ))
  (all :
    {n : ℕ} →
      (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α (n + 1)) → motive (n + 1) φ → motive n φ.all)
  (conj :
    {n : ℕ} →
      (φ : ℕ → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) →
        ((a : ℕ) → motive n (φ a)) → motive n (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.conj φ))
  {a✝ : ℕ} (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α a✝) : motive a✝ t
